- [x] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

# What does this PR do?
Reduce ordinary NCCL MoE dispatch from three data all-gathers to one while preserving the batch-invariant path

This extracts the NCCL dispatcher optimization from #8114. Hidden states, router probabilities, and routing indices are packed into aligned byte rows, gathered together, and unpacked into their original dtypes

The optimization covers both equal-token CUDA Graph dispatch and variable-token prefill dispatch. The variable-token path retains its existing token-count metadata gather. Grad-enabled execution, batch-invariant execution, tensors with different row counts, and unaligned layouts retain the original three-gather path. Token combine is unchanged

The helpers handle empty and strided inputs. No model-specific tuning was introduced.

## Validation

This PR is rebased onto main `db3a6cd8a` (no conflicts); the PR head is `ff51a2d45`. The full-model logit validation below was run before rebasing, against main `442d0183d`. After rebasing, the dispatcher and determinism suites (423 per rank, five optional-backend skips) pass on each of 4 GB300 ranks, including the new row-count fallback check, and the end-to-end runs below generated the same tokens as main in every allocation

- Distributed unit tests: 84 tests passed on every rank at both EP4 (one node) and EP8 (two nodes), with no failures or skips. Coverage includes equal and ragged token counts, zero-token ranks, all-empty inputs, strided inputs, CUDA Graph replay with updated inputs, alignment fallback, BI fallback, rank-local gradient flags, and autograd preservation
- Bit-exact packing tests: repeated packing and unpacking preserve the original bytes, including signed zero, infinities, subnormals, and NaN payloads. Coverage is registered as `inference_nccl_packed_dispatch` in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py`
- Full-model logits: all 60 comparison cells passed across Nano, Super, and Ultra: five workloads per model, eager/decode CUDA Graph execution, and shared-expert overlap off/on. Every valid prefill, mixed, and decode position and all 131072 vocabulary entries were compared through integer views, without tolerance or downcasting. All eight ranks participated, with two repeats per case per process. Input IDs, positions, generated tokens, and replay results also matched. A one-bit negative control verified the comparator
- Workload coverage: batch sizes 1, 7, 16, 31, and 32; prompt lengths from 1 to 257 tokens; output lengths of 64 or 128 tokens
- Static checks: Black, isort, pylint, Ruff, determinism-manifest coverage, and `git diff --check` passed. `tools/autoformat.sh` was run in check mode. Its non-gating mypy step reported missing local Torch imports/stubs and Optional-access diagnostics in unchanged code.

Full-model validation used GB300, two nodes with four GPUs each, TP8/EP8/ETP1, BF16 weights, FP32 router, and BI disabled. `MAMBA_DETERMINISTIC=1` and `TRITON_CACHE_AUTOTUNING=0` were set identically for baseline and candidate. In decode-graph configurations, prefill and mixed steps remained eager.

## Performance

End-to-end batch generation speedup against main `db3a6cd8a` (candidate `ff51a2d45`):

| Model | BS16 speedup | BS32 speedup |
|---|---:|---:|
| Nano | 1.100x | 1.080x |
| Super | 1.082x | 1.067x |
| Ultra | 1.059x | 1.051x |

Measurement setup:

- Two nodes, 8 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs, TP8 / EP8 / ETP1; official BF16 checkpoints converted to Megatron Core, FP32 router, FA4, decode CUDA Graphs, NCCL dispatcher (`--inference-moe-token-dispatcher-type nccl`); batch-invariant mode and prefix caching disabled; shared-expert overlap off
- 16 or 32 requests with 32–33 prompt tokens and exactly 128 greedy output tokens each
- Three independent allocations per model. Each runs four fresh processes per batch size (baseline → candidate → candidate → baseline at BS16, reversed at BS32) with five timed generations per process
- Speedup = baseline / candidate latency, using the mean of the two per-process medians; the table shows the geometric mean of the three allocation ratios and a 95% t interval on the log ratios. All samples are retained
- Triton autotune selection is pinned for both versions (`--triton-autotune-mode pinned`), so fresh processes generate comparable tokens. Generated tokens were identical between baseline and candidate in every allocation
- Timing starts after request enqueue and ends when all requests finish (prefill and decode). Model loading, warmup and tokenization are excluded

## Issue tracking

Related PR: [#8114](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/pull/8114) (original optimization PR).

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [x] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel (Triton, `jit_fuser`/`torch.compile`, CUDA extension, TE or external-library dispatch, or a scatter/index accumulation), I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test and registered it in `tests/unit_tests/determinism/kernels/manifest.py` ([guide](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/docs/developer/determinism/testing.md))
- [ ] I have added proper typing to my code [Typing guidelines](https://docs.python.org/3/library/typing.html)
- [ ] I have added relevant documentation
- [x] I have run the [autoformatter.sh](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/main/tools/autoformat.sh) on my PR

### Code review

Feel free to message or comment @NVIDIA/mcore-oncall to help accelerate your merge into main. The less complex your PR is, the faster it will be approved and merged!

All PRs start as **draft**. If you open a non-draft PR, it will be automatically converted to draft.

#### Step 1: Mark PR as "Ready for Review"

1. When your PR is ready, click **Ready for Review**.
2. An oncall reviewer is auto-assigned and expert reviewers are notified based on your changes.
   - Some PRs may jump straight to step 2. This is determined by `.github/CODEOWNERS`.

:warning: Only mark as ready once merge-conflicts are resolved and the CI is passing.
Final Review might get declined if these requirements are not fulfilled.

#### Step 2: Final Review

For PRs that change `megatron/core`, once all expert reviewers have approved, the `Final Review` label is applied **automatically** and final reviewers are assigned.

For PRs outside `megatron/core`, this step is skipped.

#### Step 3: Approved

Once all required reviewers have approved, the `Approved` label is applied **automatically**.

### Merge

Any member of [mcore-engineers](https://github.com/orgs/NVIDIA/teams/mcore-engineers) will be able to merge your PR.

+    @staticmethod
+    def _packed_row_layout(
+        tensors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+    ) -> Optional[tuple[list[int], list[int], int]]:
+        """Byte layout that packs each token's rows of several 2-D tensors into one uint8 row.
+
+        Segments are ordered by decreasing element size so each keeps its natural
+        alignment. Returns (order, byte offsets, row bytes), or None when the tensors
+        differ in row count or a segment would be misaligned; the caller then gathers
+        the tensors separately.
+        """
+        if any(t.dim() != 2 for t in tensors) or len({t.shape[0] for t in tensors}) != 1:
+            return None
+        order = sorted(range(len(tensors)), key=lambda i: -tensors[i].element_size())
+        offsets, row_bytes = [0] * len(tensors), 0
+        for i in order:
+            if row_bytes % tensors[i].element_size():
+                return None
+            offsets[i] = row_bytes
+            row_bytes += tensors[i].shape[1] * tensors[i].element_size()
+        if any(row_bytes % t.element_size() for t in tensors):
+            return None
+        return order, offsets, row_bytes
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _pack_rows(
+        tensors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...], layout: tuple[list[int], list[int], int]
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """[tokens, row_bytes] uint8 rows holding every tensor's row for each token."""
+        order, _, row_bytes = layout
+        # Empty tensors can be contiguous while retaining a non-unit last stride.
+        if tensors[0].shape[0] == 0:
+            return tensors[0].new_empty((0, row_bytes), dtype=torch.uint8)
+        return torch.cat([tensors[i].contiguous().view(torch.uint8) for i in order], dim=1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unpack_rows(
+        packed: torch.Tensor,
+        tensors: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...],
+        layout: tuple[list[int], list[int], int],
+    ) -> List[torch.Tensor]:
+        """Contiguous [rows, *] tensors shaped and typed like ``tensors``, read from ``packed``."""
+        _, offsets, _ = layout
+        return [
+            packed[:, offset : offset + t.shape[1] * t.element_size()].view(t.dtype).contiguous()
+            for t, offset in zip(tensors, offsets)
+        ]

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.
+
+"""Byte-exact packing of NCCL MoE dispatch inputs; distributed replay lives in inference tests."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dispatcher_inference import NCCLAllGatherDispatcher
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden,topk", [(128, 6), (2688, 6), (1024, 22), (2048, 22)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rows", [0, 1, 7])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("strided", [False, True])
+def test_nccl_dispatch_pack_replay(hidden, topk, rows, strided):
+    """Packing preserves every bit, including signed zero, infinities and NaN payloads."""
+    h = torch.arange(rows * hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32).to(torch.int16)
+    p = torch.arange(rows * topk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    if h.numel() >= 4:
+        h[:4] = torch.tensor([-32768, 0x7F80, 0x7FC1, 1], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int16)
+        p[:4] = torch.tensor(
+            [-2147483648, 0x7F800000, 0x7FC00001, 1], device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+        )
+    tensors = (
+        h.view(torch.bfloat16).reshape(rows, hidden),
+        p.view(torch.float32).reshape(rows, topk),
+        torch.full((rows, topk), -1, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64),
+    )
+    if strided:
+        views = []
+        for tensor in tensors:
+            storage = tensor.new_empty(rows, tensor.shape[1] * 2)
+            view = storage[:, ::2]
+            view.copy_(tensor)
+            views.append(view)
+        tensors = tuple(views)
+    layout = NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._packed_row_layout(tensors)
+    assert layout is not None
+    order, offsets, row_bytes = layout
+    assert order == [2, 1, 0]
+    assert row_bytes == hidden * 2 + topk * 12
+    assert offsets == [topk * 12, topk * 8, 0]
+    previous = None
+    for _ in range(4):
+        packed = NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._pack_rows(tensors, layout)
+        outputs = NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._unpack_rows(packed, tensors, layout)
+        if previous is not None:
+            assert torch.equal(packed, previous)
+        previous = packed.clone()
+        for actual, expected in zip(outputs, tensors):
+            assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype and actual.is_contiguous()
+            # clone normalizes even empty strides before reinterpreting the dtype.
+            expected = expected.clone(memory_format=torch.contiguous_format)
+            assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8))
+
+
+def test_nccl_dispatch_rejects_unaligned_layout():
+    tensors = (
+        torch.empty(2, 5, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        torch.empty(2, 3),
+        torch.empty(2, 3, dtype=torch.int64),
+    )
+    assert NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._packed_row_layout(tensors) is None
+    assert NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._packed_row_layout((tensors[0].flatten(), *tensors[1:])) is None
+    aligned = (
+        torch.empty(2, 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        torch.empty(2, 4),
+        torch.empty(2, 4, dtype=torch.int64),
+    )
+    assert NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._packed_row_layout(aligned) is not None
+    # Row counts must agree; otherwise the three gathers stay separate.
+    assert (
+        NCCLAllGatherDispatcher._packed_row_layout((aligned[0], aligned[1][:1], aligned[2])) is None
+    )

+        monkeypatch.setattr(NCCLAllGatherDispatcher, "_local_tokens_per_rank", [4] * ep_size)
+        dispatcher._runs_metadata_sync = False
+        hidden = torch.full(
+            (4, NANOV3_BASE["hidden_size"]), rank, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        probs = torch.full(
+            (4, NANOV3_BASE["moe_router_topk"]), rank, device="cuda", dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        routing = torch.full_like(probs, rank, dtype=torch.int64)
+        (hidden if grad_input == "hidden" else probs).requires_grad_(bool(rank % 2))
+        calls = []
+
+        def gather_local(tensor, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(tensor.dtype)
+            return tensor.repeat(ep_size, 1)
+
+        def gather_into_local(output, tensor, **kwargs):
+            output.copy_(gather_local(tensor))
+
+        # Inspect every rank's protocol before issuing real collectives. This makes
+        # a regression fail with an assertion instead of hanging mismatched NCCL calls.
+        with torch.enable_grad():
+            with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
+                patch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_gather_into_tensor", gather_into_local)
+                patch.setattr(
+                    "megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dispatcher_inference."
+                    "gather_from_sequence_parallel_region",
+                    gather_local,
+                )
+                dispatcher.routing_map = routing
+                dispatcher.token_dispatch(hidden, probs)
+            protocols = [None] * ep_size
+            torch.distributed.all_gather_object(protocols, calls, group=dispatcher.ep_group)
+            expected = [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32, torch.int64]
+            if not use_allgather_v:
+                expected.reverse()
+            assert all(protocol == expected for protocol in protocols), protocols
+
+            dispatcher.routing_map = routing
+            gathered_hidden, gathered_probs = dispatcher.token_dispatch(hidden, probs)
+        for gathered in (gathered_hidden, gathered_probs, dispatcher.routing_map):
+            expected_rows = torch.arange(ep_size, device="cuda", dtype=gathered.dtype)
+            expected_rows = expected_rows.repeat_interleave(4)[:, None].expand_as(gathered)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(gathered, expected_rows, atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize(
+        "shape",
+        [(128, 6, 8), (2688, 6, 128), (1024, 22, 512), (2048, 22, 512), (128, 3, 8)],
+        ids=["small", "nano", "super", "ultra", "unaligned"],
+    )
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["equal", "ragged", "zero_rank", "empty", "graph"])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("bi_enabled", [False, True])
+    def test_dispatch_packed_gather_matches_reference(self, shape, mode, bi_enabled, monkeypatch):
+        """Gather bytes exactly, with one data collective only on eligible ordinary paths."""
+        from megatron.core.transformer.custom_layers.batch_invariant_kernels import (
+            set_batch_invariant_mode,
+        )
+        from megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dispatcher_inference import NCCLAllGatherDispatcher
+
+        if Utils.world_size < 2:
+            pytest.skip("Packed dispatch requires EP > 1.")
+        hidden_size, topk, experts = shape
+        dispatcher = self._make_dispatcher(
+            hidden_size=hidden_size, moe_router_topk=topk, num_moe_experts=experts
+        )
+        world, rank = dispatcher.ep_size, torch.distributed.get_rank()
+        variable = mode in ("ragged", "zero_rank", "empty")
+        counts = [r + 1 for r in range(world)] if variable else [3] * world
+        if mode == "zero_rank":
+            counts[0] = 0
+        if mode == "empty":
+            counts = [0] * world
+        monkeypatch.setattr(NCCLAllGatherDispatcher, "_use_allgather_v", variable)
+        total, start, local = sum(counts), sum(counts[:rank]), counts[rank]
+        reference = (
+            torch.randn(total, hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+            torch.randn(total, topk, device="cuda"),
+            torch.randint(-1, experts, (total, topk), device="cuda"),
+        )
+        for tensor in reference:
+            torch.distributed.broadcast(tensor, src=0)
+        packed = not bi_enabled and topk != 3
+        # Exercise strided inputs on the packed path; preserve the reference
+        # variable-count path's requirement for contiguous collective inputs.
+        inputs = []
+        for tensor in reference:
+            storage = tensor.new_empty(local, tensor.shape[1] * 2)
+            view = storage[:, ::2]
+            view.copy_(tensor[start : start + local])
+            inputs.append(view if packed else view.contiguous())
+
+        calls = []
+        gather = torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor
+
+        def checked_gather(output, tensor, *args, **kwargs):
+            calls.append(tensor.dtype)
+            return gather(output, tensor, *args, **kwargs)
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(torch.distributed, "all_gather_into_tensor", checked_gather)
+        # The reference gather retains an import-time alias of this collective.
+        monkeypatch.setattr(
+            "megatron.core.tensor_parallel.mappings.dist_all_gather_func", checked_gather
+        )
+
+        def run():
+            dispatcher.routing_map = inputs[2]
+            hidden, probs = dispatcher.token_dispatch(inputs[0], inputs[1])
+            return hidden, probs, dispatcher.routing_map
+
+        def check(outputs):
+            for actual, expected in zip(outputs, reference):
+                assert actual.dtype == expected.dtype and actual.is_contiguous()
+                assert torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8), expected.view(torch.uint8))
+
+        expected_calls = [torch.uint8] if packed else [torch.bfloat16, torch.float32, torch.int64]
+        if not packed and not variable:
+            expected_calls.reverse()
+        if variable:
+            expected_calls.insert(0, torch.int32)
+        with torch.no_grad(), set_batch_invariant_mode(bi_enabled):
+            check(run())
+            assert calls == expected_calls
+            if mode == "graph":
+                stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+                stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+                with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+                    for _ in range(3):
+                        run()
+                torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+                graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+                with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+                    outputs = run()
+                for _ in range(3):
+                    for tensor, source in zip(inputs, reference):
+                        source.neg_()
+                        tensor.copy_(source[start : start + local])
+                    graph.replay()
+                    check(outputs)
+
+    def test_dispatch_keeps_autograd_with_gradients(self, monkeypatch):
+        """With gradients enabled, the gathers stay differentiable (no packed raw collective)."""
+        from megatron.core.transformer.moe.token_dispatcher_inference import NCCLAllGatherDispatcher
+
+        if Utils.world_size == 1:
+            pytest.skip("The packed all-gather requires EP > 1.")
+        dispatcher = self._make_dispatcher()
+        monkeypatch.setattr(NCCLAllGatherDispatcher, "_use_allgather_v", False)
+        hidden_size, topk = NANOV3_BASE["hidden_size"], NANOV3_BASE["moe_router_topk"]
+        hidden = torch.randn(
+            4, hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16, requires_grad=True
+        )
+        probs = torch.rand(4, topk, device="cuda")
+        dispatcher.routing_map = torch.zeros(4, topk, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int64)
+        d_hidden, _ = dispatcher.token_dispatch(hidden, probs)
+        assert d_hidden.requires_grad
+        d_hidden.float().sum().backward()
+        expected = torch.full_like(hidden, dispatcher.ep_size)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(hidden.grad, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
